Definition: 'Machalath', probably the title (initial word) of a popular song
BiblicalUsage: The word appears only in the titles of two psalms, Psalms 53 and 88, where it stands as the name of a song or tune, upon Mahalath. No verse of the psalms themselves uses the word, and its meaning lives only in those headings.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a word found only in a title is worth naming honestly, because the headings of the psalms are part of Scripture too.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
